home.title: Credential infrastructure for verifiable data.

home.searchIntro: Search public schemas, credential generations and transactions without exposing credential claims.
home.flowTitle: From a shared schema to independently verified evidence.

keys.title: No custody
keys.copy: Keys remain in each entity’s wallet or HSM.

data.title: Off-ledger claims
data.copy: The ledger stores a cryptographically bound URI, not the credential data.

trust.title: Explicit trust
trust.copy: An active, intact credential is trustworthy only when your application recognizes its issuer.

learn.title: Understand XCS step by step
learn.intro: XCS is a deterministic convention on top of native XRPL Credentials, not a new blockchain or central authority.
learn.publisher: Account that registers a schema definition with the registry.
learn.issuer: Entity asserting a fact by creating the Credential with its own wallet.
learn.subject: Affected account that accepts the Credential before it becomes active.
learn.verifier: Application checking the ledger, schema, payload and its own trust policy.
learn.indexer: Service reading every validated ledger and reconstructing queryable state.
learn.registry: Blackholed account serving as the neutral destination for schema registrations.
learn.verification: XCS reports on-ledger state, schema validity, content integrity and issuer trust separately.

schemas.title: Public schemas
schemas.description: Every valid schema is reusable. Publication does not endorse its publisher or future issuers.
schemas.empty: No schema has been indexed on this profile yet.
schemas.neutrality: This schema was published permissionlessly. Its presence in the Explorer neither endorses its publisher nor guarantees future issuers.

register.title: Register a schema
register.description: JSON is validated and canonicalized before the complete definition is placed in a Payment memo.
register.irreversible: A validated registration is public and irreversible. Corrections require a new schema.
register.uidLater: The final UID depends on validated ledger context and will be displayed by the indexer.
register.textBytes: Required · {count}/{max} UTF-8 bytes · single line. Accents and emoji use multiple bytes.
register.descriptionInvalid: Description is required: use a single line of 1–256 UTF-8 bytes. Remove line breaks or shorten the text; accents and emoji use multiple bytes.
register.nameInvalid: Schema name is required: use a single line of 1–64 UTF-8 bytes.
register.advancedHint: JSON mode remains available for inheritance, supersession and nested descriptors.

issue.title: Issue a credential
issue.description: Prepare the off-ledger payload, publish its exact canonical bytes, then sign CredentialCreate.
issue.noPii: Testnet is public, and neither HTTPS nor local test storage is suitable for personal data.
issue.httpsProof: Enter the final public URL, prepare and download the JSON, then publish it unchanged at that URL. The browser fetches it again with CORS, without cache or redirects, before opening the wallet (maximum 1 MiB).
issue.publishBeforeSigning: Publish the downloaded file byte-for-byte at {url}. The signing button will verify that publication before opening the wallet.
issue.checking: Checking the published HTTPS bytes immediately before signing…
issue.credentialLink: View and verify the exact credential
issue.advancedClaimsHint: Switch to JSON mode to review or enter the complete claims object directly.

hosted.title: Commons public payload storage
hosted.description: The exact canonical payload will be served publicly from {origin}. Never include personal data, secrets or production data.
hosted.consent: I approve publishing the exact payload displayed above at {url}, and keeping a recovery copy in this browser until publication succeeds or I remove it.
hosted.confirmExactPublication:
Publish this exact payload publicly at {url}?

{payload}
hosted.publishAfterSignature: After the credential is validated and indexed, its payload is published here and checked over public HTTPS.
hosted.publicationPending: The signature and payload are saved in this browser. Publication requires ledger validation and indexing. You can return to Issue or Operations after reloading; retrying never creates another credential.
hosted.recoveryDescription: These public payloads were saved before signing. Retry after ledger confirmation. No new transaction or wallet signature is requested.
hosted.recoveryUnavailable: Payload recovery storage is unavailable, full or corrupted. Check browser storage and pending publications before signing again.
hosted.corruptRecovery: One recovery copy is damaged and cannot be published. Other copies are unaffected. You can remove this damaged copy explicitly.
hosted.retryFailed: Publication could not be completed. The recovery copy is retained.
hosted.journalCleanupFailed: The payload is published and verified. Browser journal cleanup failed; the signed transaction may still be retained locally.
hosted.signatureMissing: No signature was recorded. Check your wallet and Operations before issuing again; the payload copy is retained here.
hosted.discardConfirm: Remove this browser recovery copy? This does not revoke a credential or delete a published payload. If publication is incomplete, keep the downloaded payload before removing it.

localStore.title: Local demonstration storage
localStore.warning: This mode keeps the payload for 24 hours only in this browser and creates a compliant content-addressed IPFS URI. It is not public, durable or available from another device. The Testnet credential remains on XRPL after local expiry.
localStore.acknowledgement: I confirm that this test payload contains no personal data, secrets or production data.
localStore.flow: When preparing, XCS automatically stores the canonical bytes in this browser. Fields such as prenom are allowed after you confirm that every value is fictitious. The CID is read back and verified immediately before opening the wallet.
localStore.stored: Payload kept in this browser until {expiresAt}. Do not share this credential as publicly available evidence.
localStore.checked: Local payload read and IPFS integrity verified ({bytes} bytes):

errors.ackRequired: Confirm the local storage warning before preparing this test credential.
errors.pii: The field “{field}” requires confirmation that the payload contains fictitious, non-personal test data only.
errors.quota: The local store already contains 20 active payloads. Clear them before continuing.
errors.missing: This local payload is missing or expired. Prepare the credential again before opening the wallet.
errors.size: The local payload must contain between 1 byte and 64 KiB.
errors.unavailable: The local test store is unavailable in this browser. Check that the local site was started with this mode enabled and browser storage is allowed.
errors.integrity: The local payload was modified or corrupted. Clear the store and prepare the credential again.

errors.hostedSize: Public storage accepts at most 64 KiB of canonical UTF-8 payload. Reduce the claims before signing.
errors.hostedConsent: Explicitly approve the exact public payload and destination before continuing.
errors.hostedUnavailable: The public payload service is unavailable or is not configured with a valid HTTPS origin.
errors.hostedBeforeSigning: The payload host is unreachable. No signature was requested. Configure a working, fixed HTTPS address before issuing this credential.
errors.hostedIntegrity: The signed transaction, public URL and canonical payload do not match exactly.
errors.hostedPii: This public storage refuses claims whose field names look like personal data.
errors.hostedQuota: This wallet or network address reached the public payload publication limit.
errors.hostedNotIndexed: The signed CredentialCreate is not yet present in the authoritative index. Wait for ledger confirmation, then retry publication.
errors.httpsUrlRequired: First enter the final public HTTPS URL where this payload will be published.
errors.httpsUrlPlaceholder: issuer.example is an example address, not a hosting service. Replace it with a public HTTPS URL controlled by your organization.
errors.payloadFetchFailed: The browser could not fetch the payload. Publish the downloaded JSON file unchanged at this public HTTPS URL with the application/json type, CORS allowed for this site and no redirect, then try again.

credential.description: Exact permalink for a shared generation. This page is not a Credential directory.
credential.subject: Subject
credential.payloadPrivacy: The Explorer displays only the anchored URI. It does not contact its host or fetch any claim automatically.
credential.verificationUnavailable: The authoritative current verification report is unavailable. Exact generation metadata and lifecycle remain visible, but no verification status is inferred.
credential.generationNotCurrent: This exact generation is historical or has been replaced for its tuple. Its metadata and lifecycle remain visible, but a newer generation’s verification report is never reused.
credential.payloadVerificationUnavailable: Payload loading is disabled because no current verification report is bound to this exact generation.

studio.title: Create verifiable credentials.
studio.description: Start with a reusable public schema, then issue a credential from your own wallet. Each action is prepared locally and signed outside XCS.
studio.nonCustodial: No XCS account is required and Commons never receives your seed or private key.
studio.manageDescription: The subject can review and accept a pending credential. The issuer can revoke it, and every local wallet operation stays recoverable in this browser.
studio.register: Create and publish a permissionless schema.
studio.issue: Produce a bound public payload and issue a Credential.
studio.accept: Review a pending Credential, then accept or remove it.
studio.revoke: Delete an issued generation with the issuer wallet.
studio.verify: Check ledger, schema, payload and trust separately.
studio.operations: Resume operations kept locally in this browser.

developers.title: Build with XCS
developers.description: Integrate the frozen v0.1 protocol with the REST API, TypeScript SDK and reference CLI.
developers.rest: Query public projections and exact evidence without indexing claims.
developers.sdk: Validate, canonicalize and prepare unsigned transactions in your application.
developers.cli: Produce and verify artifacts from a local, non-custodial workflow.

runtime.title: Active configuration
runtime.unavailable: The active profile cannot be loaded. The quickstart stays disabled until indexed evidence is available again.

quickstart.title: Verify a shared generation
quickstart.intro: Paste a generationId that was deliberately shared with you. This flow never enumerates an account's Credentials and never searches claims.
quickstart.stepGeneration: Read that exact generation and its indexed events.
quickstart.stepSchema: Load the exact schema referenced by its schemaUid.
quickstart.stepMetadata: Request metadata with resolvePayload:false and require the same current generationId.
quickstart.stepPayload: Validate the canonical bytes locally, then deliberately send the payload to the verifier without automatic resolution.
quickstart.exactOnly: Exact coordinate only: no issuer, subject or account listing is called.
quickstart.generationGuard: If the tuple now points to another generation, this flow stops before accepting a payload. It compares generationId again after the final POST.
quickstart.payloadPlaceholder: Paste the exact RFC 8785 JSON bytes from credential.json
quickstart.canonicalPayload: The content stays in memory in this tab. It must be the exact canonical JSON bound to the digest in the on-chain URI.
quickstart.transmission: Continuing sends the public claims to this API process for validation. The API does not resolve the URI or persist those claims, but it does receive them during the request.
quickstart.localAlternative: To send no claims to the API, use xcs payload check locally with a standalone schema, then keep the metadata-only report: its payload dimension remains not_checked.
quickstart.noPayloadUri: This generation has no payload URI. Verification remains metadata-only, so the payload dimension stays not_checked and no payload form is offered.

errors.replaced: This exact coordinate is no longer the tuple's current generation. No payload was accepted.
errors.generationId: generationId must contain exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
errors.payload: The local payload is not the canonical JSON object expected by the schema and on-chain URI.
errors.changed: The profile, tuple or URI changed during verification. Reload the exact evidence.
errors.generic: The exact flow could not be verified. Inspect the stable code below.

code.title: Examples derived from this evidence
code.intro: The API, profile, generation and tuple values below come from the active configuration and loaded exact response.
code.curlScope: The cURL-only example verifies the object recanonicalized by the API; it does not prove that the file bytes were already canonical. Use the TypeScript flow or xcs payload check for that local proof.
code.alpha: The SDK and CLI are not published on npm yet. These commands run from this monorepo; do not assume pnpm add or pnpm dlx is available.
code.signer: The SDK builds and autofills an unsigned transaction. Your wallet integration implements Signer, shows the final transaction to the user and remains the sole owner of signing. XCS never accepts a seed or private key.

catalog.intro: Aggregate routes support public discovery. Credential routes remain limited to exact coordinates shared by the user.
catalog.aggregateIntro: Statistics, permissionless schemas and publication activity; no account Credential catalog.
catalog.exactIntro: A UID, hash or complete tuple is required. These routes never return payload claims.
catalog.optionalIntro: Available only when the operator enables the challenge-based pinning service.
catalog.privacy: There is no subject feed, account-wide Credential list or claims search route. An issuer visible in discovery is not endorsed by Commons.

accept.title: Accept or remove a credential
accept.description: Review what was issued to your wallet, then accept or remove it.
accept.notTruth: Accepting adds this credential to your account. It does not prove its claims are true.
accept.walletNext: Your wallet will ask you to sign. Nothing is accepted until you confirm there.
accept.payloadMismatch: These details do not match the credential. Acceptance is blocked; ask the issuer to check them.
accept.rejectAction: Reject the unaccepted pending or expired credential
accept.removeAction: Remove the accepted active or expired credential
accept.payloadConsentIntro: Details are hosted on {host}. Loading them shares your IP address and request time with that host.
accept.localPayloadConsentIntro: These test details are stored only in this browser.
accept.localPayloadConsent: Load and verify these test details
accept.localPayloadUnavailable: This IPFS CID is unavailable in this browser’s demonstration store. Acceptance is blocked here.
accept.payloadUnavailable: The credential details could not be verified. Retry, or ask the issuer to check the link.
accept.issuerUnknown: XCS has not verified this issuer’s identity.
accept.issuerAcknowledgement: I recognize this issuer and want to accept this credential.
accept.issuerAcknowledgementRequired: Confirm that you recognize the issuer to continue.
accept.issuerAcknowledgementStale: The issuer trust context changed. Review it and confirm your decision again.
accept.issuerUntrusted: This verifier's local policy marks the issuer as untrusted. Acceptance is blocked.
accept.subjectWalletMismatch: The connected wallet is not the subject of this credential. Disconnect it and connect the recipient wallet before accepting, rejecting or removing this generation.
accept.rejectSafety: Rejecting deletes this unaccepted pending or expired object without endorsing its issuer or claims. This action loads neither payload nor trust status.
accept.removeSafety: Removing deletes this accepted active or expired generation from the subject account. No payload or trust status is loaded; XCS success then requires indexed deleted evidence with subject_removed (issuer_revoked for a self-issued credential).

revoke.title: Revoke an issued credential
revoke.description: The connected issuer selects the exact subject and schema before preparing CredentialDelete.
revoke.warning: Deletion is irreversible for this credential generation. Confirm the exact subject and schema in your wallet.

verify.title: Verify a credential
verify.description: Open a credential generation to inspect its ledger history, schema, payload integrity and issuer trust as separate facts.
verify.generationHint: Use the generation ID shared by the issuer or subject. XCS never exposes an account-wide credential feed.
verify.generationError: Enter a complete 64-character hexadecimal generation ID.
verify.advancedDescription: Use issuer, subject and schema UID when you do not have a generation link.
verify.fetch: Fetch and check the public payload
verify.payloadConsentIntro: Payload bytes have not been fetched. Fetching contacts {host} directly, which can observe your IP address and request time.
verify.localPayloadConsentIntro: The bytes will be read from this browser’s demonstration store. No external host is contacted and the content is unavailable on another device.
verify.payloadConsent: I consent to fetching the public payload from this exact host.
verify.localPayloadConsent: I consent to reading and verifying this demonstration payload from this browser’s storage.
verify.localPayloadUnavailable: This IPFS CID is unavailable in this browser’s demonstration store. Use the browser that created it or a real IPFS resolver.
verify.trustNote: Trust remains an application decision; XCS does not turn an unknown issuer into a recognized authority.

operations.title: Wallet operations
operations.description: Review submissions saved in this browser and resume those whose validation has not been confirmed yet.
operations.localOnly: The journal and recoverable signed blobs remain in IndexedDB on this device. No seed or private key is stored.
operations.empty: No wallet operation is stored in this browser.

footer.summary: XCS v0.1 — open standard and MIT reference implementation.

admin.queueIntro: Review pending organization applications, oldest first.
admin.verifiersIntro: Manage approved and suspended verifier access to the application.
admin.auditIntro: Decisions, their authors and notification delivery. Decisions remain recorded even when email delivery fails.
admin.reviewIntro: Review the organization and its evidence before granting application access.
admin.documentHelp: PDF, PNG and JPEG only. Authorized links are tied to your session and expire after five minutes.
admin.documentFailure: The document could not be opened. It may be missing, invalid or no longer authorized. Your application review is preserved; retry the document separately.
admin.walletCaveat: These wallets belong to the responsible person. A wallet ownership proof does not establish the identity of the organization. No XRPL transaction is needed for this review.
admin.approvalCaveat: Approval grants the selected application role. It does not endorse the organization’s claims.
admin.privateClaims: Private claims remain under recipient control. Administrator access and verifier approval do not grant access to private claims.
admin.noDecision: No further decision is available for this application.
admin.decisionRecorded: Decision recorded. Email delivery is tracked separately in audit history.
admin.reviewCurrent: Reload and review the current decision
admin.ambiguousDecision: The outcome of this request is unknown. Retry the same decision to retrieve or complete it safely. Its original details and request identifier are preserved.
admin.notificationQueued: Notification queued for delivery. The original decision is unchanged.
admin.blockedHelp: Delivery is blocked until the responsible person has a verified email. Do not repeat the decision.
admin.uncertainHelp: Delivery may have succeeded before an interruption. An operator must check the SMTP delivery record before any further send. Automatic retry is disabled.

errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Access denied. Your account no longer has the administrator permission required for this action.
errors.missing: This application or document is unavailable.
errors.conflict: Another decision was already recorded. Review the current decision before taking any further action.
errors.unavailable: The administration service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
